title: Star triangle (nested loops)
prompt:
Implement `static void program(int n)` that PRINTS a left-aligned triangle of `*` characters: row 1 has one star, row n has n stars, each row followed by a newline. `program(3)` prints `"*
**
***
"`.

tests.name: shape of three
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.program(3));
CjTestBase.checkEq(out, "*\n**\n***\n", "triangle of 3");
tests.hint: Inner loop runs row times; println after the inner loop ends each row.

tests.name: single row and five
tests.hint: n = 1 still has one row; five rows of growing width.
